changelog:
- Major update: Changed skill scope from literature review writing to thesis conclusion writing.
- Replaced English literature review workflows and search framework with detailed guidance for composing and evaluating thesis conclusions.
- Updated description, workflow, and components per the 11-element academic conclusion structure (in Chinese).
- All previous code, documentation, and search-related files were removed.
- Output and usage modes now focused entirely on conclusion writing, structure checking, and bilingual support.
summary: 论文结论部分撰写助手。基于11个通用组成部分(论文内容、研究成就、相关背景信息、研究空白/目的/需求、方法/途径、关键结果及评价性评论、结果的意义/启示、潜在或实际的局限性、潜在或实际的应用、研究如何推动知识进步、未来的研究方向)帮助用户检查、评估、改进或重写论文结论。适用于需要撰写学术论文结论、审查结论质量、或...
